column3: Life Counseling Session
I understand your feelings, but it's already late at night.
We will talk about it tomorrow, all right? Let's sleep for now.
It's your duty to do something right now.
Guh...! So my existence's only purpose to do my sister's life-counseling bidding?!
I get it! I'll give a call to Kuroneko, will that do?
Glad you get it...
My sister just can't be honest.
Well, covering for his sister is a brother's duty.
To be honest, it's really troublesome... Geez, what a pain.
Okay, my cellphone is in my room, so I'm going back to make the call.
Well now, will Kuroneko answer...
What?
Is it Kuroneko? So hey...
Hmph, if it's to beg me to join the tournament, it's useless to say anything.
Oh really?
What do you mean by that?
All right!
I skillfully seized the initiative of the conversation!
I have to say something to get Kuroneko to waver, even if it's just one word. If there's a chance, I'll take it!
You do know her skills are really bad? If an expert player like you doesn't join, there's no meaning for us to participate in this tournament!
I said that with a lowered voice in case Kirino were to put her ear against the wall to hear our conversation.
...Oh my, I didn't really hear that, could you repeat it once more?
As, I, said... Kirino is really bad--
Not that, what you said after.
Didn't she hear it?
If an expert player like you doesn't join--
I don't understand, I'm considered an expert when compared to...?
That would be Kirino...
It's a given that your sister plays poorly. What else?
It's still not enough?!
And also... er... everyone? That's right, that's it. Mere humans could never win against you.
...Hmph. It seems like you were able to feel a part of my true powers.
Anyway, I don't have anything else to say about this matter.
Wait! I do want to see you parti--
She hung up...
Kuroneko?!
I do want to see you parti-- and after?
Well... I mean, "I do want to see you participate."
I see... It can't be helped then.
Then!
Since you asked me like that... I'll grant your request.
Why did she change her mind so suddenly...?
Anyway, this difficult mission is now complete.
That's right, even Kirino recognizes your abilities deep inside.
Good, she's wavering now...
I am a word away from persuading her.
If I get this right, this elite mission will be completed.
However, my sister's got even me working so hard for her...
We absolutely need to you to raise our chances of winning.
We don't have a chance without you, you know that right?
Chances of winning? What are you saying while half asleep?
Eh?
The word "defeat" does not exist for battles I partake in. The concept of luck is meaningless to me.
...In other words?
If Senpai and I were to join, when that very day comes, the skies of Akihabara will be blackened with my dark vortex.
What's that...?
The objective of this tournament is complete victory, that's all.
Ah, that's right.
In order to win, it's only suitable for me to support you who doesn't have much experience with the game.
Furthermore, if that fashion monger and Saori were in a group, their strength would be more stable, don't you think?
Hmph... When I explained that to her, she was enraged and put an end to the conversation.
Ah, I see... Wait! I'll be pairing up with you?!
Seriously?! Won't I end up only dragging you down?!
However, this is the best combination.
But...!
And the word defeat doesn't exist in my dictionary, I believe I said so earlier.
There's always an "if"!
...W-What's wrong?
You don't want to be pair up with me?
That's not the case...
Is that so? Then everything is fine.
Anyway, you do understand my plan, right?
Ah, ah... I understand the gist of it.
In short, Kuroneko devised a very complex strategy to win the tournament that involves me pairing with her and told Kirino about it.
And with that kind of coercive talk, she roused Kirino's wrath as usual... That's probably it.
You're also doing your best for Kirino's sake.
...What are you talking about?
Acting like she doesn't know? Geez, she's not being honest.
For the tournament... I'm counting on you, Senpai.
Eh? Does this mean...? Kuroneko, you're willing to join the tournament?
...Hmph.
Hey! Don't hang up on me! Hey, heyyy!
...Why did she change her mind so suddenly?
Anyway, this difficult mission is apparently complete...
Hmph. Did you think I would lend my hand to a mere human being?
Don't say that. You're not the kind who can run away without fighting right?
I am... running away?
Of course, that's not what I think, but what about Kirino?
She will spread the word in the community that you deserted in front of the enemy! I know that for a fact. She's that kind of girl!
Indeed... With that girl, it's very likely.
Will you deny everything on a case by case basis?
Silent, Kuroneko pondered for a while...
It can't be helped... It will cost you.
Well then!
Hmph. I get it. I'll grant your request.
I see! Thanks!
Doing that for your sister, you're getting good at this.
Well, looks like it became a habit.
But this time, you'll reap what you sow.
Why? Did I do something?
Did your sister tell you why we were fighting?
Kirino was angry because you reduced her to ashes in the game?
Not only that.
Huh? Then, why were you fighting?
Who knows? Think about that yourself.
Hey! ...What was that at the end?
Anyway... I can consider this mission complete... I guess?
